title: Replication Data for: Virtual reality and smartphone utilization for the examination and enhancement of working memory load for visual and auditory dual tasking.
descriptions: This dataset includes condition (task) types (independent variables), and reaction times (dependent variable) as an indication of working memory load for different task types and manipulations.
